66836616: When using Kecare as a blog, we need a landing page (i.e., the homepage) to display the list of blog articles.
1d7a2d00: The landing page template is a `.list.ts` file stored in the `.kecare/` directory. The generator will call it after processing all articles to generate the article list page.
c56f878b: In summary, `.list.ts` only requires you to return an array containing `fsPath` and `template`, and the generator will correctly call the template to generate the page. Since pagination design is needed, the theme author needs to write the pagination logic here. The array can also contain a single item (if you are not doing pagination design, you can directly return fsPath: xxx , template: xxx).
d8c09892: We called `<Landing/>` in the template, so next we should move on to writing the page component.
7767d2ce: In Vue, the way to use data is through text interpolation, i.e., ` 文章标题: {{ article.frontMatter.title }}` this form. Simple, right? That's probably all there is to it. As for the specific styles, you'll have to use your imagination.
